alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 22 at 7:37PM PST until November 23 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Widespread High Risk for Transportation as visibility of one
half to one quarter mile or less in dense fog will be observed.

* WHERE...The San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 10 AM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways affected include interstate 5,
highways 99, 46, 43, 41, 198, 180, 168, and 152.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
